deps.edn.reason: Git dependencies on kami-* repositories become one source each so the same namespaces are not loaded twice: kami-eizo-timeline, douga and kami-ongaku-project are the kotoba monorepo's lib/kotoba.kamiEizoTimeline, lib/kotoba.douga and lib/kotoba.kamiOngakuProject, where they now live (JUN-649); douga was the archived standalone repository at an old commit. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, alias :cljs, alias :pages, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :e2e): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.
